# Transporeon: Market Insights API (market metrics and rate benchmarks)

- **Product:** Transporeon: Market Insights API (market metrics and rate benchmarks) (Transportation family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** HTTP bearer token. Declared security schemes: tokenAuth.
- **Access:** Transporeon Insights subscribers.
- **To call it you would need:** a Transporeon Insights token for insights.transporeon.com.
- **Documented servers:** `https://insights.transporeon.com`.
- **Definition:** [transporeon/inline-market-insights-api](https://transporeon-hcskb.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ADPD/pages/1303347218/Market+Insights+API) (Market Insights API, version 1.1.0). Documentation: https://transporeon-hcskb.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ADPD/pages/1303347218/Market+Insights+API.

## Core Metrics

| Method | Path | Disposition | Summary | Parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/metrics` | `reference` | All metrics |  |
| `GET` | `/v1/metrics/{metric_id}` | `reference` | Single metric | metric_id* (path) |
| `GET` | `/v1/metrics/{metric_id}/lane` | `reference` | Metrics by lane | metric_id* (path); from_time* (query); to_time* (query); from_lvl1* (query); to_lvl1* (query); from_lvl2 (query); to_lvl2 (query) |
| `GET` | `/v1/metrics/{metric_id}/predictions` | `reference` | Predictions for a single lane | metric_id* (path); from_lvl1* (query); to_lvl1* (query); from_lvl2 (query); to_lvl2 (query) |
